note: Live-session recording of the SharePoint episode screens (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Set MG_TENANT, MG_UPN_DOMAIN and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID in the environment before queueing (never in a file). Sign-ins are device-code, done by the owner. Episodes 1-9 chain: set MG_KEEP_CHAIN=1 while recording them in order so teardown keeps what the next episode uses; unset it for a full clean-up. Two sessions: day 1 provisioning, schema mapping and re-index; day 2 (after the crawl) the search tests. MG_EP4_DATE must be the date episode 4's sample files were generated (yyyy-MM-dd).
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }

screens.name: termstore
steps: Open SharePoint admin center > Content services > Term store
Hold on the General tab with the Unique Identifier ending in ...1e10
mask: tenant name and admin host in the address bar
admin account in the top bar

screens.name: library-category
steps: Open Supplier Documents and switch to a flat view ('Show all items without folders') with Name, Supplier, Category, Expiry date
Hold on Fabrikam = Cleaning, Northwind Traders = Paper and Toner, Tailspin Toys = Merchandise, Adventure Works = Vehicle Leasing, scan_0001.txt without a category
mask: tenant host in the address bar (pipeline/mask.js)
account avatar and display name in the top bar

screens.name: schema
steps: Site settings > Site Collection Administration > Search Schema > Managed Properties
Filter 'Refinable' and open RefinableDate00 (Edit Managed Property)
Hold on Alias 'PurchExpiry' and the mapping to the ExpiryDate crawled property (ows_q_DATE_ExpiryDate or ows_ExpiryDate, whichever is listed)
Second capture: the list filtered 'Refinable' showing RefinableString00 PurchSupplier, RefinableString01 PurchDept, RefinableDate00 PurchExpiry, RefinableDate01 PurchInvoiceDate
After saving the four mappings, off camera in a terminal run: ./src/Invoke-SearchMetadata.ps1 @p -CheckMapping -Reindex (expect 'No findings'), then wait for the crawl
mask: tenant host in the address bar
screens.note: Day 1. Write the crawled property names you chose into search-plan.json afterwards.

screens.name: search-tests
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
if (-not $env:MG_EP4_DATE) { throw 'Set MG_EP4_DATE to the date the episode 4 sample files were generated (yyyy-MM-dd)' }
screens.note: Day 2, after the crawl. Expect four mappings read back, 'No findings', six PASS lines, '6 passed, 0 failed'; record what it really says.

teardown: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }

if ($env:MG_KEEP_CHAIN -ne '1') { Remove-PnPField -List 'Supplier Documents' -Identity PurchCategory -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-PnPField -Identity PurchCategory -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-PnPTermGroup -Identity 'Contoso Purchasing' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
